product_metadata.title: 224 Pieces Pantry Labels for Kitchen Canisters, Preprinted Bold Black Font on Clear Stickers for Food Storage Containers and Jars (Water Resistant)
features: Labels for Kitchen Organization: Create a picture-perfect kitchen with this set of 224 preprinted jar labels for pantry organization; the stickers include 216 commonly used ingredients, such as Baking Powder, Baking Soda, Corn Starch, Beans, Bread Flour, Cake Flour, Chocolate Chips, Cocoa Powder, Coffee, Nuts, Popcorn, Powder Sugar, Tea, All Purpose Flour, Bread Crumbs, Brown Rice, Chips, Cookie, Corn Meal, Pancake Mix, Pasta, Rolled Oats, White Rice, White Sugar, and Whole Wheat Flour

Stay Fresh: Place the household labels on your food storage container of choice to create a functional, organized, visually appealing workspace when baking or preparing meals; suitable for pantry containers with lids, tall glass canisters, and jars

No Messy Handwriting: These pantry labels for containers feature black all-caps lettering preprinted on water-resistant vinyl with a self-adhesive backing that can easily be removed or replaced as needed

Uniform, Organized Kitchen: The clear labels for pantry storage comes in assorted sizes for picture-perfect kitchen organization; the labels vary in size depending on the length of words and number of lines; the font is 0.75 inches tall

Comes With: This 224-piece set comes with 216 preprinted kitchen labels for canisters and 8 numbers stickers; you will also receive a comprehensive, alphabetized list of the label names for easy reference; NOTE: Set does not include food storage containers
